titleZh: 僵硬 ↔ 柔韌｜水泥柱 vs 瑜珈墊
hook: 水泥柱（inexorable/mulish）對瑜珈墊（pliant/docile/amenable）——性格柔韌度對打。
script: 僵硬隊：inexorable／mulish／pigheaded 不彎。柔韌隊：amenable／pliant／docile 能折——教練：inexorable about integrity；pliant on tooling。

members.senseAnchor: 無可說服的；無法改變的
members.zhGloss: 無可說服的；無法改變的
members.speakLineEn: Russia's final hour, it seemed, approached with inexorable certainty.
members.speakLineZh: 無可說服的；無法改變的。

related.synonyms: grim, relentless, stern, unappeasable, unforgiving, unrelenting

members.speakLineEn: His mulish refusal to revise one paragraph cost the team an easy rewrite win.
members.speakLineZh: 他固執如驢、拒絕改一段文字，讓小組錯失輕鬆重寫拿分的機會。

members.speakLineEn: Even clear photos could not shake her pigheaded belief that the rumor was true.
members.speakLineZh: 即使有清楚照片，也動搖不了她那頑固的謠言信念。

members.speakLineEn: New volunteers proved amenable to the schedule once the coach explained the reason.
members.speakLineZh: 教練說明原因後，新志工變得很聽話、願意配合時間表。

related.antonyms: defiant, rebellious, obstinate, stubborn, domineering, assertive, intractable

members.speakLineEn: Heat made the plastic strip pliant enough to bend around the model frame.
members.speakLineZh: 加熱後塑膠條變得柔軟，足以彎繞模型骨架。

related.synonyms: plastic, ductile, malleable, pliable, tensile, tractile

members.speakLineEn: The usually lively puppy grew docile after a long walk in the park.
members.speakLineZh: 平常活潑的小狗，在公園長走後變得溫順安靜。

members.speakLineEn: She joined a lunchtime yoga class to loosen stiff shoulders after typing all morning.
members.speakLineZh: 打字一整早後，她去上午休瑜珈課放鬆僵硬肩膀。

members.speakLineEn: Workers poured fresh cement for the new sidewalk outside the science building.
members.speakLineZh: 工人在科學大樓外，為新行人步道灌注新鮮水泥。

members.speakLineEn: You must bend the wire carefully so the circuit board connector fits without snapping.
members.speakLineZh: 你必須小心地彎曲線材，才能讓電路板接頭卡住又不折斷。

members.speakLineEn: The stubborn printer jammed again until someone cleared the wrinkled paper path.
members.speakLineZh: 那台固執的印表機又卡住，直到有人清掉皺紙紙道。

members.speakLineEn: The softness of the new sweater made winter mornings feel almost gentle.
members.speakLineZh: 新毛衣的柔軟觸感，讓冬日早晨幾乎變得溫柔。

members.speakLineEn: Athletes stretch their calves before every sprint so the muscles stay loose.
members.speakLineZh: 選手每次衝刺前都會伸展小腿，讓肌肉保持放鬆。

members.speakLineEn: One loose brick near the library steps needed to be reset after the rain.
members.speakLineZh: 雨後圖書館台階旁有一塊鬆動的磚，需要重新嵌好。

members.speakLineEn: The lab stool had a rubber foot that stopped it from sliding across the floor.
members.speakLineZh: 實驗凳有橡膠腳墊，能防止在地板上滑動。

members.speakLineEn: Whether the grant arrives on time is the hinge of our entire spring timeline.
members.speakLineZh: 補助是否準時到位，是整個春季時程的關鍵。

members.speakLineEn: During the surprise lockdown drill, hallway doors stayed shut for fifteen minutes.
members.speakLineZh: 突襲封鎖演練期間，走廊門關閉了十五分鐘。

members.speakLineEn: After a long debate, the committee offered a small giveway on the deadline rule.
members.speakLineZh: 長辯論後，委員會在截止期限規定上做了一點讓步。

members.speakLineEn: The sculpture used recycled steel beams from an old bridge downtown.
members.speakLineZh: 這座雕塑使用了市中心舊橋拆下的回收鋼樑。

members.speakLineEn: First-year art students pressed wet clay into simple bowls for the kiln.
members.speakLineZh: 大一美術生把濕黏土壓成簡單碗形，準備進窯。

members.speakLineEn: Leave your muddy shoes on the entry mat before walking into the classroom.
members.speakLineZh: 進教室前，請把泥鞋放在門口墊子上。

members.speakLineEn: She tucked a soft bolsterpad behind her back during the long bus ride home.
members.speakLineZh: 坐長途公車回家時，她在背後塞了一個柔軟靠墊。

members.speakLineEn: A patient donkey carried picnic baskets up the short trail to the overlook.
members.speakLineZh: 一頭耐心的驢子，把野餐籃馱上通往觀景台的短步道。

members.speakLineEn: The old riding glove still had a thin whipcord loop sewn at the wrist.
members.speakLineZh: 那隻舊騎馬手套腕部，仍縫著一圈細細的鞭繩。

members.speakLineEn: Watch the gymnast flex her wrists slowly before she mounts the uneven bars.
members.speakLineZh: 看體操選手上高低槓前，慢慢屈曲手腕熱身。

members.speakLineEn: Engineers bolted a rigidbar across the frame so the shelf would not sag.
members.speakLineZh: 工程師在框架上鎖上一根硬棒，避免架子下垂。
